notes: fw v0.1.2 — the zero-typing provisioning firmware: WiFi-only first-boot form, POST /provision, + all audit repairs + the TFT block protocol.

bug_fixes: The panel reported the wrong version number (0.1.4) - every version field in the build now carries the true release version, verified byte-for-byte in the binary before shipping
The display reflash task shipped in the previous build predated the corrected upload protocol - this build contains the complete per-block upload (no more stalls at 95%)
The previous display image was a splash-only test picture - this release ships the full panel interface
features: The display now receives the full authored interface: clock page, date, AM/PM, relay cards with touch toggles
